title: mallotus baillonianus
intro: Mallotus baillonianus, commonly known as the Simalakama or Yellow Myrtle, is a plant species in the family Euphorbiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mallotus baillonianus include its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its use in wound healing and skin problems due to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Mallotus baillonianus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
